# MyVendor\Cms

API Document

## Routes (8)

| HTTP Route | Methods | Resource |
|------------|---------|----------|
| /article | GET, POST, PUT, DELETE | App/Article |
| /articles | GET | App/Articles |
| /author | GET, POST, PUT | App/Author |
| /categories | GET | App/Categories |
| /category | GET, POST, PUT, DELETE | App/Category |
| /media | GET, POST, DELETE | App/Media |
| /tag | GET, POST, DELETE | App/Tag |
| /tags | GET | App/Tags |

## ResourceObjects (8)

### App/Article
`/article`

| Method | Parameters | Links |
|--------|------------|-------|
| GET | id* | href(goArticleList), href(goAuthor), href(goCategory) |
| POST | slug*, title*, body*, authorId*, categoryId*, excerpt, status, publishedAt | - |
| PUT | id*, title*, body*, status*, excerpt, publishedAt | - |
| DELETE | id* | - |

### App/Articles
`/articles`

| Method | Parameters | Links |
|--------|------------|-------|
| GET | page, perPage, categoryId, tagId, status | href(goArticle) |

### App/Author
`/author`

| Method | Parameters | Links |
|--------|------------|-------|
| GET | id* | href(goArticleList) |
| POST | name*, email*, bio | - |
| PUT | id*, name*, email*, bio | - |

### App/Categories
`/categories`

| Method | Parameters | Links |
|--------|------------|-------|
| GET | - | href(goCategory) |

### App/Category
`/category`

| Method | Parameters | Links |
|--------|------------|-------|
| GET | id* | href(goCategoryList), href(goArticleList) |
| POST | slug*, name*, description, parentId | - |
| PUT | id*, name*, description, parentId | - |
| DELETE | id* | - |

### App/Media
`/media`

| Method | Parameters | Links |
|--------|------------|-------|
| GET | id* | - |
| POST | filename*, mimeType*, url*, alt, width, height | - |
| DELETE | id* | - |

### App/Tag
`/tag`

| Method | Parameters | Links |
|--------|------------|-------|
| GET | id* | href(goTagList), href(goArticleList) |
| POST | slug*, name* | - |
| DELETE | id* | - |

### App/Tags
`/tags`

| Method | Parameters | Links |
|--------|------------|-------|
| GET | - | href(goTag) |

## Query Interfaces (5)

| Interface | Methods |
|-----------|---------|
| ArticleQueryInterface | getById(id):Article, getBySlug(slug):Article, list(categoryId, tagId, status, limit, offset):array |
| AuthorQueryInterface | getById(id):Author, getByEmail(email):Author |
| CategoryQueryInterface | getById(id):Category, getBySlug(slug):Category, list():array |
| MediaQueryInterface | getById(id):Media, getByFilename(filename):Media |
| TagQueryInterface | getById(id):Tag, getBySlug(slug):Tag, list():array, listByArticle(articleId):array |

## Entities (5)

| Entity | Properties |
|--------|------------|
| Article | id, slug, title, body, status, authorId, categoryId |
| Author | id, name, email, bio |
| Category | id, slug, name |
| Media | id, filename, mimeType, url, width, height |
| Tag | id, slug, name |
